summary: Iteration 47: Comprehensive testing of new Lectures Module. All 21 backend tests PASSED (100%). Frontend UI verified for Teacher and SuperAdmin roles. Features tested: CRUD operations, config endpoint, admin endpoints (admin-all, admin-stats, activity-logs), duplicate, PDF export (teacher/student/revision variants), filtering, and search. Frontend verified: Lectures nav in sidebar, lecture list with cards, 3 creation modes (AI Generate, Upload & Generate, Write Manually), admin tabs (Overview, My Lectures, All Lectures, Activity Log), lecture detail view with Edit/AI Refine/AI Component/Duplicate/Publish/PDF buttons.

issues: HTML hydration warnings: <th>/<td>/<tr> cannot be child of <span>. Known issue from previous iterations - doesn't affect functionality.
